note: Newest first. where: live = the normal app, test = the test version (/test/), android = the Android app.

entries.title: New app: Boardgames
items: Boardgames is here: shelves for Board games, Wishlist, and Miniatures & terrain, plus Plays. Open it from its tile in The Nightvault (add it on the Apps screen).
Your BoardGameGeek collection, wishlist and plays come in by themselves every morning (once the BGG user name and token are set on GitHub).
A game and its expansions share one tile. Groups, groups inside groups, pins, tile covers and Select work like in Music and Bookcase.
Each game has a page with box art, players, play time, complexity, BGG rating and rank, your rating, plays and the expansions you have.
Log a play: date, players, scores and who won (★). The Android app sends it to BGG right away (Settings → log in to BGG once); when you are offline it goes later.
Add games that are not on BGG, and miniatures and terrain (which game or army, how many, paint), with your own photo.

entries.title: New app: Games
items: Games is here: a list of your computer, console, retro and handheld games and a wishlist. Open it from its tile in The Nightvault (add it on the Apps screen).
Shelves per platform (PC, Switch, PS2 …) plus All games and Wishlist. A shelf appears by itself when you add a game for that platform.
One tile per game with all your copies inside: digital (Steam, GOG, Epic, eShop …) or physical with what's included (sealed, complete in box, loose) and the region (PAL, NTSC-U, NTSC-J).
Organised like Music: series tiles by themselves (Zelda, Half-Life …), your own groups, groups inside groups, select several, pin, tile cover, undo, Sort by and search everywhere.

Find games by name with their cover via IGDB, more covers via SteamGridDB, and import your Steam library and wishlist. These need your own free keys: Games ⚙ → Online lookup. They stay on your phone only.
Backup: Games ⚙ → Save all my games.

entries.title: Audiobooks: organised like Music and Bookcase
items: Books in a series share one tile (in series order, #1, #2 …); an author's other books share a tile too (Settings → Bundle books by author).

The same groups as Music and Bookcase: + Group, groups inside groups, ⋯ → Put in a group…, Add books…, Rename, Choose the tile cover, ★ Pin, Select several and move them, Undo, and Save my groups in Settings.
Tapping a book opens its page first: Continue / Listen, previous and next in the series, details and bookmarks. Grouped / All books and Sort by on every page; search also finds groups.
The series is read from the files (series tags), from a title like "Mort (Discworld #4)" or from folders (Author / Series / Book). Books added before: ⋯ → Read the book info again, or Edit details.
An author folder with one file per book now becomes separate books.

entries.title: Bookcase: comics by publisher
items: Comics are now bundled by publisher: Comics › Marvel › Spider-Man › the volumes. The publisher comes from the comic itself (ComicInfo.xml), or from your folders (Comics/Marvel/…).
It is a setting per shelf: shelf ⚙ → "Bundle series by publisher". On for Comics, off for Books, Manga and the other shelves - switch it on there if you want it.
Moving things by hand still wins, and you can fill in or change the publisher with Edit details. Shelf ⚙ → "Read the details of all books again" fills it in for books you added before.

entries.title: New: Nightvault Bookcase
items: A new app in The Nightvault: Bookcase. It opens on shelves - Comics, Manga, Books, Rulebooks, RPG and Colouring books - and you can make your own shelves.
Add books from a folder on your phone (nothing is copied) or copy them into the app. It reads CBZ, CBR, PDF, EPUB and folders of pictures, also with WebP and AVIF pages.
Series are bundled behind one tile by themselves, in the right order. Groups, groups inside groups, pins and moving work just like in Music.

One reader for everything: it remembers your page, turn pages by tapping the edges or swiping (right to left for manga), pinch or double-tap to zoom, two pages side by side on a wide screen, night mode, bookmarks, contents, search inside PDFs, and the next volume at the end.
Print the whole book, one page or a range of pages (on Android you can also choose Save as PDF).

entries.title: Music: rename groups, undo, a backup of your groups, search inside groups
items: Rename a group: group ⋯ → Rename. Your own group keeps everything in it; for an artist or series tile only the name on the tile changes.
Undo: after moving, adding, taking out, removing or renaming, the message at the bottom has an Undo button for a few seconds.

A backup of your groups: Settings → Your groups → Save my groups (to Google Drive, mail …) and Load from a file. Your groups, groups inside groups, albums you placed by hand, tile covers and pins come back on a new phone.
Search looks inside groups: matching groups show as tiles, and every album found says where it is (like “in Star Wars › Episode I”).
Behind the scenes: the group logic is now one shared part of The Nightvault, so the other apps get exactly the same groups later.

entries.title: Music: fix - choosing the cover of a group with groups inside
items: Fixed: for a group with other groups inside (like Star Wars), tapping a cover under "Choose the tile cover" did nothing when that album sat in one of the groups inside. It now becomes the tile cover.

entries.title: Music: pin tiles to the top
items: Album ⋯ or group ⋯ > "★ Pin to the top": the tile always shows first, on the main page, inside a group or on an artist page - whatever the sort order. A small gold star marks it.
Pin several at once: select them (long-press) and tap ★ in the bar at the bottom.
Tap "Unpin from the top" (or ★ again) to put it back in its normal place.

entries.title: Music: select several tiles and move them at once
items: Long-press a tile (or tap "Select") and tap more tiles - albums and groups together. They get a tick.
The bar at the bottom: "Move to…" puts them all in a group, a new group or back on the main page. Inside a group, "Take out" moves them one level up.
Cancel or the back button ends selecting.

entries.title: Music: groups inside groups, and add albums from a list
items: A group can hold other groups: for example a STAR WARS tile with "Episode I", "The Mandalorian" and game music inside, each with its own albums. Group ⋯ > "New group inside", or "Put this group inside another group…".
Group ⋯ > "Add albums…": a searchable list of all your albums - tick several and add them at once. It shows which group each album is in now. Works for your own groups and for artist tiles.
A tile shows what is inside ("2 groups · 6 albums"); Play, Shuffle, Save to phone and the totals go over everything inside.
A group name now matches whole words only, and the longest name wins ("Star Wars Episode I" before "Star Wars").

entries.title: Take with me: music from your PC, and save it to the phone
items: The Nightvault > My PC (computer button at the top): connect to the Nightvault PC app over your home Wi-Fi. On the PC: Settings > Phone access > Switch on, then type its address and code here.
Music shows the PC's albums with a small PC sign, in the same library. Albums that are already on the phone show once, and the phone copy plays. When you are away from home, PC songs are greyed out.
"All / On this phone / On my PC" next to the sort menu shows just one side.
Album (or group, or playlist) > Save to phone: as an offline copy in the app, or as real files in your music folder (e.g. on the SD card) - kept for good. WMA/APE are converted to MP3 by the PC.
Album ⋯ > "Keep on this phone" turns an offline copy into a normal phone album. The Nightvault > My PC lists all offline copies with their size, to remove or keep.
Album ⋯ > "Put in a group…": move an album into a group tile (or a new one), or take it out to its own tile; "Back to automatic" undoes it.
Group ⋯ > "Choose the tile cover": one of the covers inside, a random one, changing covers, or a picture from the phone.
"Sort by" on every page: artists, playlists, inside groups and artists, inside playlists and in search results.
"Various" and "Various artists" are now one artist.

entries.title: Music: artist and series tiles, totals
items: Albums now come in groups: all albums of one artist (e.g. Avril Lavigne) in one tile, and compilation series like Thunderdome (Thunderdome 06, IV, 2001, "Various - Thunderdome 2003" …) in one tile. The tile shows how many albums are inside.
Make your own group with "+ Group": every album with that word in its name or artist goes in that tile.
Inside a group, an artist or an album: number of albums, songs, total length and GB, with Play and Shuffle for all of it. The Albums page shows the totals of your whole library at the top.
"Grouped" / "All albums" next to the sort menu switches the groups off.

CD numbers in the middle of an album name are recognised too: "Thunderdome 2008 (CD1) - Early Rave" and "(CD2) - Hardcore" become one album, with the CD names shown on the CD blocks. Your library is fixed by itself.

entries.title: Music: the debug log says Music
items: The debug log now names Music "Music" instead of "Audiobooks" (they are one app underneath).

entries.title: Music: cover names and a clear message when covers can't be looked up
items: Any picture with "front" in its name (front.jpeg, Front.JPG, …-front.jpg, Frontcover.png) is taken as the album cover.
Fixed: a cover was skipped when a word in its name only started like a skipped word ("Disco … Front.jpg" looked like "disc").
When the cover website can't be reached (some Wi-Fi networks, like at work, block it), Music now says so and suggests mobile data, instead of "Nothing found".

entries.title: Music: Covers folders win, better online search
items: A picture in a Covers / Scans folder (next to the songs or in the CD folder) now always wins over the CD picture inside the songs - also with a plain name like 01.jpg. Back, cd1, inlay and similar are still skipped.
Run Settings → "Look for changes" once to get these covers for music you already added.
"Find a cover online" also searches with loose words and with numbers as Roman numerals (Thunderdome 06 = Thunderdome VI).

entries.title: Music: every CD of an album folds open on its own
items: In an album with more CDs, each CD is its own block: its CD picture, "CD 1" / "CD 2", number of songs and length, and a play button for just that CD.
Tap a CD to fold its songs open or closed. They start folded; the CD that is playing is open.
The CD picture comes from a picture in that CD's folder or the Covers folder named like cd1 / disc 1, else from the picture inside its songs (the disc scan).

entries.title: Music: pick the cover from the album's own folder
items: Album ⋯ → "Change the cover picture" now shows the pictures in that album's folders first (the album folder, its CD folders and Covers / Scans folders). Tap the right one.
"Find a cover online" and "Pick from elsewhere on the phone" are right below.
For music added before this update: Settings → "Look for changes" next to your folder once, so Music knows which pictures are in it.

entries.title: Music: CD1 and CD2 in one album, better covers
items: Albums split over CDs ("Album (CD1)", "Album - CD 2", "Disc 2", or folders called CD1 / CD2) are now one album, with Disc 1 / Disc 2 inside. The tile shows "2 CDs".
Your library is fixed by itself when you open Music; favourites, play counts and playlists come along.

Covers: the picture in the album folder (front, cover or folder.jpg - also in a Covers / Scans / Artwork folder) now wins over the picture inside the songs, which is often a scan of the CD. Pictures like cd1.jpg, back.jpg or inlay.jpg are never used as the cover.
To get the folder covers for music you already added: Settings → "Look for changes" next to your folder.
Album ⋯ → "Find a cover online": pick the right cover from MusicBrainz. Settings → "Find missing covers online" does it for all albums without a cover (only when the album name matches exactly).

entries.title: Music: debug log shows how far adding songs got
items: With Debug mode on, Music now writes down when adding songs starts, how far it got (every 250 songs), when the app went to the background, and whether it was interrupted.

entries.title: Music: adding a big folder no longer stops when the phone sleeps
items: While Music adds songs from a folder, the screen stays on, so the phone doesn't go to sleep and stop it.

If it is stopped anyway (phone locked, app closed), the songs read so far are kept, and the next time you open Music it asks "Continue where it stopped?" - it then skips the folder search and the songs that are already in.

entries.title: Music: see what it does while looking in a big folder
items: While Music looks through a big folder or an SD card, it now shows how many songs it found so far, how many folders it looked at, which folder it is in and how long it has been busy, with a moving bar.
A Stop button, in case you picked a folder that is too big. Tip: pick the music folder itself, not the whole SD card.
While reading the songs afterwards, the song it is reading is shown under the bar.

entries.title: Music: first version
items: New app in The Nightvault: Music. Open it from its tile (Apps → install it first if you don't see the tile).
Add → "Use a folder on this phone": pick your music folder. Nothing is copied - the songs play from there. (On the website the songs are copied into the app.)
Albums with big covers, Artists, Songs, Playlists and search. Albums, artists and covers come from the song tags, or from the folder names (Artist / Album / 01 Song) when tags are missing.
Now playing: big cover, shuffle, repeat (all or one song), queue, favourite heart, sleep timer. Swipe the cover to go to the next or previous song.
Your own playlists, plus Favourites, Most played, Recently played and Recently added.
Remembers what was playing and where. Controls on the lock screen, in the notification and on Bluetooth headphones.
Plays MP3, FLAC, M4A/AAC, OGG/Opus and WAV. WMA and APE files can't play on a phone - the app tells you how many it skipped.

entries.title: Audiobooks: chapters of LibriVox books
items: Chapters are now found in M4B files that keep their chapter names spread through the book (LibriVox books, for example).
For a book added before: ⋯ → "Read the book info again".

entries.title: Audiobooks: books from a folder play now
items: Fixed: books from a folder on the phone got the wrong part of the file, so they did not start and their title, author and length were missing.
For a book added before this fix: open it, tap ⋯ → "Read the book info again".

entries.title: Debug mode
items: The Nightvault → bottom → "Debug mode" (or Audiobooks → Settings): the apps write down everything that happens.
A bug button then shows the log: "Copy for Claude" to paste it into a chat, "Share", or "Send to GitHub" - pick which app it is about and that app's chat can read it.
Android: the app's own Android messages can be added to the log too.

entries.title: Audiobooks: books from a folder, second try
items: Books from a folder on the phone are read in a safer way, with a second way to read them when the first one does not work.
If a book still does not start, a message appears with "Check the file": it shows what goes wrong - send a screenshot of it.
About this book → "Read the book info again" fills in the title, author, length and chapters of a book that was added without them.

entries.title: Audiobooks: play from a folder, no copy
items: Add → "Use a folder on this phone": pick the folder with your audiobooks and they play from there - nothing is copied, so no extra space.
Every book folder inside it becomes a book; loose M4B/MP3 files directly in it are a book each. You check the list before anything is added.
Settings → Folders on this phone → "Look for new books" adds books you put in the folder later.
"Copy files into the app" is still there, for books you want to keep after deleting the originals.

entries.title: Updates for every app
items: The Nightvault now looks for updates itself, so you get them even without Scanner installed.
Android: it tells you which of your apps changed, and only asks when something new is there for the apps on your phone (or a new app came out). "Later" hides that update.
What's new and Check for updates are at the bottom of The Nightvault; What's new only shows news for the apps you have.

entries.title: Audiobooks in the app list
items: Audiobooks can now be installed from Apps in The Nightvault (the previous build still showed it as "coming later").

entries.title: New app: Nightvault Audiobooks
items: Audiobooks is now a real app in The Nightvault: open Apps and install it.
Tap Add and pick the files of a book: one M4B, one long MP3/M4A, or all the MP3s of a book at once. They are copied into the app, so they play without internet.
Remembers where you were in every book, with chapters (also inside M4B and MP3 files), bookmarks, speed from 0.5× to 3.5× and a sleep timer.
Android app: keeps playing with the screen off, with play/pause and skip buttons in the notification and on the lock screen.

entries.title: Back button in the binder
items: In a set or a game in Binder, the back button now goes back one step (to the set list, then the game list) instead of straight to the tiles.

entries.title: The app starts on The Nightvault
items: The Android app now opens on The Nightvault: the tiles for Scanner, Binder, Convert and the apps coming later. Tap a tile to open it.
Your collection stays exactly as it was.
The back button on the first screen of Scanner or Binder takes you back to the tiles.

entries.title: Logo screen fits every phone
items: The word Nightvault on the screen you see when the app opens is no longer cut off at the edges, also on narrow phones or with a big text size.

entries.title: The Nightvault: even more apps coming
items: The Apps screen in The Nightvault (test) now also shows Nightvault Cinema, Boardgames, 3D Print, Collectables and Games as coming later.
They can't be installed yet - this is only to show how they will look.

entries.title: The Nightvault: new apps coming
items: In The Nightvault (test), the Apps screen now shows three apps that are on the way: Nightvault Bookcase (books, manga, comics and rulebooks), Nightvault Music and Nightvault Audiobooks.
They can't be installed yet - this is only to show how they will look.

entries.title: The Nightvault: Scanner and Binder tiles
items: In The Nightvault (test) this app now has two tiles: Nightvault Scanner (the whole app) and Nightvault Binder (only your binders, no tabs and no scanning). Both use the same collection.
Opened normally, nothing changes in this app.

entries.title: The Nightvault (test)
items: A first test of The Nightvault: one home screen with a tile per Nightvault app - Binder (this app), Convert, and more later. Open it at brokeuh.github.io/nightvault-pocket/hub/.
When you open Binder from there, a small button at the top left takes you back to the tiles. Opened on its own, nothing changes.

entries.title: Bigger card pictures
items: Cards whose picture on the card site is small are now enlarged to fill the screen in the big picture too.

entries.title: Swiping, part 2
items: The big card picture uses the full width of the screen again; the ‹ › buttons now sit on the sides of the picture.
You can also swipe left and right in the card window itself (before opening the big picture) to go through the cards.

entries.title: Swipe through cards
items: In the big card picture, swipe left or right (or use the ‹ › buttons) to go to the next or previous card of the set - or of your search results. When you close it, the card window shows the card you ended on.

entries.title: Better card search in the binder
items: Searching a name on a game's set list now finds every card with that name in it, in every set: for Magic all Chandra cards and all their printings, for Yu-Gi-Oh! every matching card, and for the other games their complete card list.

entries.title: Find a card in every set
items: On a game's set list, type a card name (like “pikachu”) and you see that card from every set at once, with how many you have. Tap one to add it or see its price.

entries.title: New app icon format
items: The app icon is now a modern Android icon: no more white frame on the start-up screen, and on the home screen it takes the icon shape of your phone.

entries.title: Search in your binders
items: Inside a binder set: a search box for name, type, rarity or number. Several words narrow it down, like “mage spell” or “fire rare”.
On a game's set list the search box now also finds your own cards by name or type - tap one to open it.

entries.title: Start-up screen
items: The app icon on the start-up screen no longer sits on a white circle: the background now has the app's dark colour.

entries.title: Hearthstone screen capture (alpha)
items: Android app, optional: Settings → “Hearthstone screen capture (alpha)”. Binder → Hearthstone → Screenshots then offers “Capture from Hearthstone”.
Hearthstone opens with a floating 📷 button: tap it on every page of your collection (drag it out of the way if needed), then ✕ to come back. The app reads the captured pages straight away.
Android asks to allow “Display over other apps” the first time, and to record the screen each time you start. This is an early test - tell us what goes wrong.

entries.title: Hearthstone screenshots: ×2 and golden
items: Reading Hearthstone screenshots now sees the “x2” badge under a card, and golden copies by their gold frame. Tuned on real screenshots from the Hearthstone app.
Cards that were reprinted with the same picture always go to the same set.

entries.title: Read Hearthstone screenshots, back button fix
items: Binder → Hearthstone → Screenshots: pick screenshots of your Collection in the Hearthstone app and the app recognises the cards on them (golden copies too). Check the list, set ×2 where needed, and add them. Reading the same page twice never doubles your cards.
Android: the back button now always steps back inside the app - big picture, then the card window, then the set list - also after you opened the big picture of a card.

entries.title: Hearthstone
items: New game: Hearthstone. Every expansion is a binder set, with Normal and Golden copies. The card list updates every week.

Hearthstone cards are digital: they count in your collection and binders, not in its value. Instead of a price you see what a card costs to craft in dust, and how much dust the rest of a set or deck needs.
Build Hearthstone decks: 30 cards, 2 copies of a card (1 of a Legendary), one class plus Neutral cards.
Deck menu: “Copy Hearthstone deck code” to make the deck in the game, and “Paste a Hearthstone deck code” from the game or a deck website.

entries.title: Shadowless Base Set and special-print pictures
items: New binder set “Base · Shadowless” next to Base and Base · 1st Edition, with its own Shadowless prices (TCGplayer).
Mark a single card as Shadowless in the card window when you add it (Base Set only).
1st Edition and Shadowless cards now use the TCGplayer picture of that print where one exists. Some of these pictures may still show the normal print.

entries.title: Check for updates
items: Settings → What's new now starts with your version and a “Check for updates” button (also in the full What's new list).
While the app is open it also looks for a new version every 20 minutes, and each time you come back to it after a few minutes.

entries.title: 1st Edition prices for every WotC set
items: 1st Edition prices now come from a daily list of TCGplayer's 1st Edition prices (about 930 cards of Base Set to Neo Destiny), so they also work when the Pokémon card site is down.
When the Pokémon card site fails to load a set (“HTTP 500”), the app now loads the same set from TCGdex instead.
“What's new” now also shows an update when lines were added to it later.

entries.title: 1st Edition as its own set
items: Pokémon sets with 1st Edition prints (Base Set, Jungle, Fossil, Team Rocket, Gym, Neo) now appear twice in the binder: the normal set and “… · 1st Edition”, each with its own progress, value and missing cards.
In the 1st Edition set, Tick off and “I have the whole set” add 1st Edition copies, and its value uses the 1st Edition prices.

entries.title: Fixed: updates refused (“signatures do not match”)
items: Every Android build was signed with a different key, so Android refused to install a new build over the old one. From build 14 every build has the same signature.
One last time: back up your cards (Settings → Backups), uninstall the app, install build 14, and restore the backup. After that, updates install over each other.

entries.title: 1st Edition
items: Mark copies as 1st Edition (Pokémon's first Wizards sets - Base Set, Jungle, Fossil, Team Rocket, Gym, Neo - and Yu-Gi-Oh!): with the EN button when scanning, in the binder card window, or in My cards.
A 1st Edition copy is its own entry with its own price: TCGplayer's 1st Edition price for Pokémon (never the price of the normal print), or your own price.
Sets with 1st Edition prints get a “1st Ed” tag in the set list; inside such a set a “1st Ed” switch makes Tick off add 1st Edition copies, and cards show a small gold “1st” mark.
“I have the whole set” can add the set as 1st Edition.

Fixed: 1st Edition copies could get the price of the normal print when the Pokémon card site was slow - they now only take a 1st Edition price (TCGplayer), and copies that got a wrong price are looked up again.
The card window in the binder shows the 1st Edition price next to the normal one.

entries.title: Digital copies apart, Pokémon prices
items: Digital copies no longer add to the counter on a card: the number shows your physical copies, a small purple “D” shows you have it digitally.
“I have the whole set” counts physical and digital apart, so you can add a set digitally and later physically (or the other way round).
My cards shows physical cards and digital ones separately; only physical cards count in the value.
Pokémon cards without a price (new sets, or when the Pokémon card site is slow) now get their Cardmarket price from TCGdex.

entries.title: Updates inside the app
items: “Download” in the update bar now downloads the new version inside the app and opens the installer - no more copies in your Downloads folder, and the file is removed after the update.
The first time, Android asks to allow Nightvault Pocket to install apps: allow it once, come back and tap Download again.
Fixed: updating from inside the app could end with “App not installed” - the app now hands the whole update to Android's installer first, and says why if an update fails.

entries.title: Tour, whole sets and digital cards
items: New “How to use the app” tour: opens the first time, and is always in Settings and at the bottom of Home.
Binder → a set → ⋯ → “I have the whole set”: add every card at once (or only the ones you miss), physical or digital, normal or foil. “Remove all my cards of this set” undoes it.
Digital copies (with the EN button, or a whole set): counted in your collection and binder, not in its value, and not sent to Nightvault on the PC.

entries.title: Back button
items: The phone's back button now steps back inside the app (close a pop-up, leave a settings page, back to the set list ...) instead of closing the app. Only on the start screen does it leave the app.

entries.title: Updates without reinstalling
items: The app now checks for a newer version by itself (when you open it or come back to it) and shows “A new version is ready” - tap Update.
The Android app shows “Download” for a new version: install it over the old one, your cards stay.

entries.title: What's new
items: This list: see what changed in each update, with the older updates below it.

entries.title: Camera screen in the app's style
items: Before the camera starts you see a card frame in your theme colours instead of a grey box.

entries.title: Every printing, languages and graded cards
items: The scan result now finds all printings of a card (not just the first ten or so), with “All printings” and a search box.
Not in the list? Type the set code and number printed on the card - it is looked up, or added as you typed it.
New “EN” button next to Foil: mark the language (Japanese, German, French ...) and graded copies (PSA, BGS, CGC, SGC ... with the grade).
Each language and grade is its own entry in My cards, with a small badge, and can have its own price.

entries.title: Android app (test)
items: Nightvault Pocket as an Android app, with Google's text reader on the phone: faster and much better at reading card names.
Settings → Scanning can switch back to the web reader to compare.
Files you export open the Android share menu (Drive, mail, Files).

entries.title: Better at reading card names
items: Names on coloured or silver bars are read word by word, with a sharper second read and a taller box when the card is not exactly in the frame.
Pokémon cards are found by the number at the bottom (like 150/217) - also when the name cannot be read.

entries.title: World of Warcraft TCG card text
items: Card text for about 7,800 WoW TCG cards, read from card pictures - search it in the deck builder.

entries.title: Two-way sync with Nightvault on the PC
items: Added, fewer and removed cards travel both ways, exactly once.
Decks, wishlist, your own prices and the order of price sources are shared too.

entries.title: New icons
items: The icons inside the app are redrawn in the style of the new logo.

entries.title: New look
items: New app icon: fanned cards under a constellation.
Splash screen with the logo in the colours of your theme.
Home screen with tiles for scanning, binder, decks, upcoming releases and syncing; settings behind the gear.
Game emblems, and your own logo or picture per game.

entries.title: Decks
items: Deck builder for every game: search by name or card text, with filters (cost, colour, type, rarity ...), sets and “cards I have”.
Cost curve, value, what you own and what is missing; paste and copy deck lists.
Deck rules per deck (deck size, sideboard, copies of a card), with the usual rules for known games.
Add to a deck from the binder and the scanner.

entries.title: Prices from several sources
items: Cardmarket, TCGplayer and your own price, in the order you choose - no price at the first source, then the next.
Prices sheet per card with every source, shop links and eBay sold listings.
Daily prices for many more games, also old out-of-print ones.

entries.title: Binder and releases
items: Set lists grouped by product type (main sets, Commander, Secret Lair, decks, promos ...).
Upcoming releases: card game sets coming out soon, updated every day.
